payload.name: pc-check-tcp-port-list
payload.description: Pure-logic validation of a TCP-port list. Accepts only a nonempty list of exact integers, each in 1..65535 inclusive. Missing, null, scalar, empty, bool elements and out-of-range values fail closed by returning valid=false with ports=[]. Always assigns result = {valid: boolean, ports: original list if valid else []}. No imports, I/O, host calls or UUIDs. Target input/result contract: input mapping key 'ports' must be a nonempty list; each element must be an integer (not a boolean) in 1..65535 inclusive; a missing or null 'ports' key yields valid=false. Missing typed-runner prerequisite: the inputs mapping and Monty integer transport are a target interface, not guaranteed deployed runtime support; the selected runner must preserve exact integer semantics and reject booleans before dispatch. No approval claims.
